title: joint-dual-replay-fast: opt-in adapter removing the joint-dual replay's per-output triple scans (1.74x replay stage, identical checks)
body:
# joint-dual-replay-fast: opt-in adapter removing the joint-dual replay's per-output triple scans (1.74x on the replay stage, identical checks)

Aaron Wang, with help from opencode. Verifier engineering; **no kappa, no certificate, supplier or selected-frontier change**. Apache-2.0.

## Scope

- Card: `replay-runtime` (scope key `b1dd41940c60d240b47a`; chooser OS nonce `24ae43237c3eaed2410bcdf516d854cd`; priority revision 3; base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`).
- **Card selection note (pair-collision).** My first-choice drawn card `portable-replay` (scope key `831cc1a3c8f9ff01b197`) matched the fresh claim posted 2026-10-14T11:24Z in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166 (completed as https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1834), so per the collision rule I took my second-choice card. Recorded as a card-selection change in `research/joint-dual-replay-fast/TASK.json`.
- **Object (scope refined).** One measured replay bottleneck: the per-output full-triple scans in `scripts/experiments/binary_frame_replay.py:replay()` on the pinned words `certificates/joint-dual-word-{23,25}.json.gz` (frozen chain `research/joint-dual`, source freeze `research/joint-dual/SOURCE.json`, enforced by `joint_dual_compose.check_sources()`). This is the independent word check of the PR25-PR58 frame-compiler line and the dominant cost of its longest isolated test module (`tests/test_joint_reclaim.py`). Verification throughput only.

## The measured bottleneck

cProfile of `replay()` on the h=23 word (CPython 3.12, Windows): 2.045 s total, **0.84 s** in the per-output full-triple scan `expected=sum(1<<i for i,t in enumerate(triples) if common in t and not(set(t)&(set(triple)-{common})))` and `tt=[i for i,t in enumerate(triples) if common in t]` (1,020,119 generator iterations at that line; 5,336 outputs x 1,771 triples).

## What the package does

`research/joint-dual-replay-fast/fast_replay.py` re-executes the historical replay body with **every assertion, both full-basis orientations and the receipt identical**, replacing only those scans with containment masks over the same `combinations(range(h), 3)` enumeration: `expected(common, triple) = center_mask[common] & ~pair_mask[common][x] for x in set(triple)-{common}`, which is exactly the literal condition. `check_word` (including PR64/rfu08's cancelling-scatter control, retained verbatim) and the whole transitions stage are the frozen historical implementations, imported unchanged. **Nothing frozen is modified**: the historical scripts, certificates and `tests/test_joint_reclaim.py` keep their bytes and their pins — the opt-in adapter pattern of `research/ck-dyadic-replay-fast`.

## Evidence (all in the package; `RESULT.json` is the recorded receipt)

- **Identical receipts:** historical vs adapter `replay` receipts equal on both pinned words and equal to the recorded receipts in `certificates/joint-dual-compiler.json`; the delegated transitions stage equals `certificates/joint-dual-transitions-{23,25}.json`.
- **Full cross-check:** on all **12,261** outputs of both words the mask algebra equals an independently written literal scan.
- **Oracle matrix:** the exact twelve mutations of the frozen `tests/test_joint_reclaim.py` (11 rejections + scatter-reversal acceptance) on both words, both checkers: 24 cases, every accept/reject outcome agrees with the historical module, and the documented rejections reject.
- **Failure controls:** a corrupted containment table is detected by the cross-check (40/44 mismatching outputs at h=23/25); an unchecked word rejects; `-O` entry refuses ("Assertions must remain enabled"); source-freeze and word pins re-verified every run.
- **Adoption simulation:** the unmodified frozen test module runs against the adapter through `shim/binary_frame_replay.py` and passes all 16 tests (`verify.py` runs this as a load-bearing control).

## Before/after wall time (same fixture; timings are measurements, never a correctness gate)

Paired alternating runs, CPython 3.12, Windows (`BENCHMARK.json`):

| Fixture | Historical median | Adapter median | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `replay()` on both pinned words (5 pairs) | 2.233 s | 1.285 s | **1.74x** |
| frozen `tests/test_joint_reclaim.py`, unmodified (3 pairs) | 41.47 s | 37.72 s | 1.10x |

The unit fixture clears the stated target of at least 25% (42% reduction). The suite fixture improves only 10% because most of that module is JSON deep-copies, early rejection paths and the unchanged transitions stage; no coverage was dropped to improve either number.

**Retained checks:** `check_word`, every replay assertion, both full-basis orientations, the unchanged transitions stage, and the frozen test module as oracle. **Invalidation:** containment tables are rebuilt from the word on every call — no persistent cache, no staleness; freeze/pin bindings are re-checked each run.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/joint-dual-replay-fast --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/joint-dual-replay-fast
python3.12 -I -B research/joint-dual-replay-fast/benchmark.py
```

Expected: `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`, `PASS_JOINT_DUAL_REPLAY_FAST_EQUIVALENCE` then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/joint-dual-replay-fast outcome=completed`, and paired timings in `BENCHMARK.json` (values vary by machine). The documented gate `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'` passes 42 tests at base and after this change (this PR adds only `research/` content).

## Limitations / remaining obligations

- Opt-in only: the repository-wide suite wall time benefits only if a maintainer later adopts the adapter, which would require superseding the `research/joint-dual/SOURCE.json` freeze. This PR does not do that.
- Domain is exactly the two frozen words at h in {23, 25}; the mask identity is unit-tested on synthetic shapes up to h=12 but no other word is claimed. Not checked: the C++ profile stage of `verify_joint_dual.py`, `make frontier1094-verify` and any cold replay of the selected construction (not affected by this change).
- No mathematical claim of any kind.

## Overlap

Entry and submission-time `scripts/find_overlap.py` refreshes (complete pagination: 519/537 open PRs, 489/521 discussion records, 2026-10-14T12:06Z and 13:05Z) found no work on this object. Distinct from `research/ck-dyadic-replay-fast` (CK dyadic row kernels), `research/git-provenance-stream` (research_package git batching), `research/omission-lanes-seed92`, `research/rational-containment-performance` (different replays) and discussion 1547's gzip full-payload adapter (different artifact).

- Workflow precedent, credited not modified: `research/ck-dyadic-replay-fast` (opt-in adapter pattern; paired benchmark receipts) and `research/git-provenance-stream` (timings as measurements).
